company_description:
Quillstone Payments is a privately held financial-services company founded in 2013 and headquartered in Hamburg. It builds payment and money-management tools for small merchants, including card terminals, a point-of-sale app and a business account; it has also added a personal account for merchants’ customers. The company serves millions of merchants across Europe and the Americas and has around 2,500 employees working across roughly 20 offices. Its teams span product, engineering and operations, with machine-learning work focused on customer-support automation and fraud detection.

Quillstone emphasizes ownership, teamwork and learning from mistakes. Teams have autonomy to own their services and solve merchant problems, guided by shared principles rather than heavy process. The culture values pragmatism, humility, candid feedback and sharing context openly. It is office-first, with some flexibility agreed within teams, and supports professional development through training budgets, peer feedback, internal tech talks and twice-yearly development-plan reviews. The company also supports local business education projects and publishes an annual inclusion report.

results.title: Careers at Quillstone | Our culture
results.content:
Our culture
We trust our teams: each team owns its services and decides how to solve merchants' problems. We value pragmatism, humility and candid feedback, and we expect people to share context openly.
We work office-first
Quillstone is an office-first company: we believe working side by side most days helps us build better products for merchants, learn from each other faster and enjoy the work more. Teams agree a few flexible days, but the office is the default.
Our values
Take ownership - act like an owner of the outcome.
Team first - optimise for the team, not for yourself.
Learn from mistakes - we say what went wrong and improve together.
Learning culture: training budget, regular peer feedback and internal tech talks.
